context: Osterreichisches Kunstmuseum staff and contractor expense reimbursement policy, effective FY2026 - covers travel, meals, conservation materials, and loan-handling expenses.

validation_rules.notes: Applies to all categories; Stefan Koenig approves exceptions.
validation_rules.requirement: Original receipt must be attached for any expense over EUR 25.

validation_rules.notes: Aligns with the EUR 400 personal-spend threshold.
validation_rules.requirement: Travel above EUR 400 requires director or deputy director sign-off in advance.

validation_rules.notes: Required for finance team QuickBooks entry.
validation_rules.requirement: Invoices must show VAT line items for accounting reconciliation.

validation_rules.notes: Source: ECB euro reference rates daily fix.
validation_rules.requirement: Convert to EUR at the daily ECB reference rate on the transaction date.

validation_rules.action: Reduce to cap and note variance
validation_rules.notes: Source: BMKOES travel guidance Annex B.
validation_rules.requirement: Per diem caps follow Federal Ministry guidance: Vienna EUR 35, EU cities EUR 50, non-EU EUR 65.

validation_rules.notes: Friedrich Hofmann is the current head of conservation.
validation_rules.requirement: Conservation purchases require head of conservation co-signature.

validation_rules.notes: Vienna Modern uses project code VM-2026.
validation_rules.requirement: Loan transit insurance must be coded to the specific exhibition project line.

validation_rules.notes: Confidential donor names entered by Joyce only.
validation_rules.requirement: Donor and patron dinners require itemised receipts and attendee list.

validation_rules.notes: Aligns with Austrian tax-deductible mileage rate.
validation_rules.requirement: Personal car mileage reimbursed at EUR 0.42/km, capped at EUR 200/month per employee.

validation_rules.notes: Catalan and Spanish receipts from Joyce's Latin American partner trips are common.
validation_rules.requirement: Receipts in non-German languages require a brief English translation note.
